lines.text: Every room starts with a key.
This boarding house, in Legazpi, has thirty-three.
For years, her books lived on this.
Did any of it talk to the rest?
One ledger, in her own layout, that adds itself up.
Tenants pay from their phones, with GCash.
Repairs are tracked, from request to done.
Strangers can ask about a vacant room. No account needed.
Nine hundred thirty-seven of her records came with it.
Quality, four point five three, out of five.
